item_reviews.comment: Round 5: 73.22 vs next-best 70.64 (Llama); 66.36 vs 62.51 (Gemma). Highest in T1.
Matches T1: Llama R3/R4 trailing (66.58<67.23, 69.99<70.39); leads Llama R5 and all Gemma rounds.
Method M exceeds Mult-Full, Rand, UAB, LCL in all six model-round cells.
All four values exceed seed (48.90>48.67, 72.28>72.23, 39.18>38.88, 63.38>62.85), though margins are tiny.
E.g., Max-Reward Gemma MMLU 42.48 and Min-Len Llama MMLU 50.62 exceed Method M.
Package states single runs except Rand and no significance tests or confidence intervals.

missing_core_findings.description: Monolingual training (Mono) was not better than multilingual training overall: on Gemma2-2B Mono win rate fell (43.01 to 38.11) and was far below Mult-Full (about 57-60), while on Llama3-8B Mono was comparable to Mult-Full. Method M beat Mono in all cells except none.
